svg.title: DreamFlutter butterfly
svg.desc: 1:1 vector trace of docs/design/assets/butterfly-icon-original.png (scripts/brand/trace_butterfly.py). Default colours are the original's, measured. Add class="themed" to the svg element to recolour with --bf-bg, --bf-line, --bf-core, --bf-wing, --bf-glow (gradient stops mix --bf-wing and --bf-glow by --t). See docs/design/brand.md.
